articles.title: Trump Says He’s Calling Iran’s Bluff in Eight-Minute Interview With WSJ
articles.mainIdea: Trump Says He’s Calling Iran’s Bluff in Eight-Minute Interview With WSJ
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Trump Says He’s Calling Iran’s Bluff in Eight-Minute Interview With WSJ. President Trump told the WSJ’s Meridith McGraw that Iran has until Tuesday night to reopen the Strait of Hormuz or he will destroy all of the country’s bridges and power plants. Indeed, the U.S. and Israel appear to have a set of targets lined up in Iran designed to cripple its economy and ensure the regime’s recovery from this war is long and painful. “If they don’t do something by Tuesday evening, they won’t have any power plants and they won’t have any bridges standing,” Trump told McGraw.
